title: Bananas Are Berries but Strawberries Aren't
description: Botanists have a strict definition of a berry, and it gives some surprising answers.

scenes.text: Is a banana a berry? According to scientists, yes it is.
scenes.subject: banana

scenes.text: To a botanist, a berry is a fruit that grows from a single flower with one ovary, and usually holds several seeds inside.
scenes.subject: berry

scenes.text: By that rule, bananas, grapes and even tomatoes are berries. But the strawberry is not, because its seeds sit on the outside.
scenes.subject: strawberry

scenes.text: Pumpkins and cucumbers count as a kind of berry too, while raspberries do not.
scenes.subject: pumpkin

scenes.text: So the berry aisle has been lying to you. Follow for more weird facts.
scenes.subject: fruit
